verdicts.reason: A: the FIZZBANG! logo is too big. It sits on a cropped scrap of the pop-art graphic and competes with the headline. The headline wraps badly, leaving "can" alone on its own line, and the CTA is tiny and hard to read. B: the headline sits on one line and clearly leads, with a sensible left-to-right order of logo, headline, CTA. Its flaws are a logo shrunk almost to illegibility on a tiny graphic stub, CTA text squeezed together ("Shop theArt Cans"), and nearly all of the original's colourful geometric artwork gone, so the banner reads as plain white.
